objective: One clean production flow with explicitly independent subsystems

market.rule: Odds/popularity may affect only value and purchase judgement after prediction seal; never pure ability ranking.

validation.rule: Validation uses leakage-safe ledgers and cannot write into live prediction outputs.

model_certification.rule: Golden-case parity and leakage checks are independent from race-day operation.

site_dictionary.rule: Terminology generation never changes horse ranking or betting logic.

emergency_repair.rule: Manual-only repair path; not part of normal production sequence.

retired_workflow_policy: Historical experiments, one-off diagnostics, backfills and V2-V14 replay calibration workflows live in .github/workflow-archive and cannot trigger automatically.
no_mix_rules: PURE_PREDICTION must not read odds, popularity, payout or target result fields.
MARKET_EV_GATE must not rewrite pure prediction rankings.
RESULT_INGEST starts only after races complete and must not modify sealed historical predictions.
MODEL_VALIDATION must remain separate from production writes.
SITE_DICTIONARY and SITE_DEPLOY must remain separate from racing model state.
